fact: Jembi says Mozambique launched real-time digital birth registration in July 2024 by connecting MGDH-Birth and e-SiRCEV, piloted in 19 health facilities in Inhambane Province with over 11,589 newborns registered.
The CRVS Law and Policy Compendium says the revised Civil Registration Code (Law No. 12/2018) established the e-SIRCEV electronic system, integrated with national ID and health systems.

The Direccao Nacional dos Registos e Notariado portal describes the e-RCEV electronic civil registration and vital statistics system, using USSD, SMS and web to register births and deaths, with proposed coverage of all civil registration centres.
system: Sistema de Registo Civil e Estatisticas Vitais (e-RCEV)

fact: Jornal Notícias reports the Government intends to digitise civil registration through the Digital Economy and E-Government sub-projects, with the Ministry of Justice responsible for birth registration, and registrars can enter data on the digital platform once online.
system: plataforma digital de registo de nascimento

fact: Kabum Digital says the SRN online portal lets users carry out civil registrations including requesting certificates, name changes and birth registration (registo de nascimento).

UNICEF's birth registration brief says the national eCRVS has been rolled out with all 165 conservatories in Mozambique now digitised, and health-CRVS interoperability reached 152 of 300 eligible health facilities.
